ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.keybind.open.h: Opens the black-market terminal: wallet, exchange, pit and wire.
ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.control.title: Sundowner Net
ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.settings.netOp: Master switch. Turn it off to cut the crew's access — a blockade, a crackdown, or simply being too far out.
ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.settings.playe: When off, only the GM can open it. The GM can still show it to the table.
ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.settings.trade: Buying in and cashing out do not count. A resting order costs a slot on the day it fills, not the day you place it.
ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.settings.gambl: One play is one bet. Climbing a rung of the Ladder or taking another hand is not a new play.
ssv-silver-gull-sundowner.settings.drive: Advancing the day restocks the shops
Fires a day-advanced hook the shop module can listen for, so one button moves the whole economy.
